items.question: According to the authors, how are advances in language modeling expected to help network representation learning, and how might graph modeling feed back into language modeling?
items.gold_answer: The authors say that advances in language modeling may continue to produce better latent representations for networks. They also argue that language modeling can be viewed as sampling from an unobservable language graph, so insights from modeling observable graphs may improve modeling of those unobservable ones.
items.evidence_quote: Advances in language modeling may continue to generate improved latent representations for networks.

items.question: What do the authors believe language modeling is effectively doing, and what implication does that have for the relationship between observable and unobservable graphs?
items.gold_answer: They believe language modeling is sampling from an unobservable language graph. This implies that methods for modeling observable graphs can provide insights that improve models of unobservable graphs.
items.evidence_quote: In our view, language modeling is actually sampling from an unobservable language graph.

items.question: How do the authors describe the relationship between graph modeling and language modeling, and what future research directions do they name?
items.gold_answer: They describe the relationship as mutually beneficial: language modeling may improve latent representations for networks, while graph modeling may improve language modeling. Their future work will investigate this duality further, use the results to improve language modeling, and strengthen the theoretical justifications of the method.

items.question: Under which goals do the authors plan to continue their future work, and what specific aims do they list for that work?
items.gold_answer: The authors plan to continue work by investigating the duality between language modeling and graph modeling. Their stated aims are to use their results to improve language modeling and to strengthen the theoretical justifications of the method.
items.evidence_quote: Our future work in the area will focus on investigating this duality further, using our results to improve language modeling, and strengthening the theoretical justifications of the method.
